resources.string: No activation steps needed. Return to Sukut to choose a mode.
On your computer: Sukut → Phone → Activate Sukut
Some apps, such as banking apps, need Developer options off. On some phones this also stops Sukut; if so, activate again when you need it.
Your phone couldn’t keep up with the sound, so Sukut stopped. Press Start to try again. If it happens often, choose more buffering in Engine performance.
The audio worker stopped. Tap Activate Sukut to start it again.
Android didn’t let Sukut start in the background. Open Sukut and press Start.
Android refused Sukut access to the sound. Activate Sukut again, then press Start.
Sukut couldn’t connect to your phone’s sound. Press Start to try again.
The sound stopped unexpectedly. Press Start to try again.
When nothing is playing, Sukut rests to save battery. You can leave it on in the background.

Activation on the phone needs Wi-Fi. A phone hotspot works, even without internet. If Wi-Fi disconnects, Sukut can stop; when Wi-Fi is back, Sukut turns Wireless debugging on again by itself if it can, or turn it on and tap Activate.
